verdict.line: You lose if you dump full Q chains into his E poke and let his passive stack into free shield; you win if you trade in short bursts and force the all-in after level 6.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise passive turns any drawn-out exchange into free magic shield the moment he lands two ability hits, while Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance rewards a short burst-then-reset pattern instead of a marathon trade. Whoever controls the length of the trade wins the lane, not whoever starts it. The 51.1% win rate over 646 games and the measured solo-kill edge both say Aatrox wins that fight when he plays for the short burst instead of the extended brawl.

theirWindow.when: After he lands E poke pre-6
theirWindow.what: He'll try to close with Q (Obliterate) to melee-finish what his E started. Don't hard-engage into a fresh E hit — step back out of Q range and make him walk the gap before you commit, since his E has real recovery and punishes you for closing distance for free.

yourWindow.when: After your W (The Darkin Blade's Chains) lands
yourWindow.what: Immediately follow with your empowered Deathbringer Stance auto into Q3 for max burst before he can trigger W (Indestructible) and convert the damage into shield. This is your actual kill window, not a poke window — commit the full combo instead of a single auto.

start.why: 51.7% win rate over 592 games at 71.8% pick — the AD and sustain proc keep you even in the poke exchanges before you have your full combo.

boots.why: 51.5% win rate over 489 games at 65.2% pick. His stacked-passive empowered auto and E poke are magic damage, so the flat MR blunts both his harass and his all-in burst.

core.why: The proc damage and shield reward you for landing the burst combo in one window instead of trading autos with him.
Ability haste and the on-hit shield let you reset faster into the next short trade instead of committing to a long one.
Most-picked finisher on this path (45.7% win rate over 35 games, 8.3% pick) — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his passive-empowered auto after you all-in.

runes.keystoneWhy: The ramping adaptive force and heal-on-stacks give you the sustain to win the level 6+ all-in outright, matching the matchup's real win condition of forcing a decisive fight instead of poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 79.2% of games at 50.6% win rate — Ignite cuts through his W shield conversion and regen right when you commit the level-6 all-in, which is your actual win condition in this lane. Flash+Teleport (50%, 17% pick) is the alternative if you're expecting a passive, wave-management lane instead.

playing.title: Trade in bursts, not brawls
playing.detail: Land your combo, get your empowered auto off, and disengage before he can land two more ability hits. Every extra ability hit he lands on you is a free stack toward his passive-empowered auto and shield.

playing.title: Respect his E range pre-6
playing.detail: Don't walk into his E poke to start your own Q. Bait it on minions or wait for it to be down before you engage.

playing.title: Combo off your W root
playing.detail: Your win condition all lane is landing Chains and immediately dumping Deathbringer Stance plus Q3 before he can activate W (Indestructible).

playing.title: Track his ult for isolated duels
playing.detail: His R (Realm of Death) removes outside interference, which cuts both ways — use it to close out a duel when your jungler is nearby to prevent his help, and avoid triggering it yourself when you're not ahead in the fight.

playing.title: Punish empty passive stacks
playing.detail: If he's thrown out E and Q without landing them, his passive is empty — that's your safest window to force an all-in since his empowered auto isn't up.

playing.title: Itemize MR early if poked out
playing.detail: If his E is consistently chunking you pre-6, prioritize Mercury's Treads over Steelcaps and consider Maw of Malmortius over Death's Dance in the build.

playing.title: Use Ignite to seal level 6
playing.detail: His W self-sustain and shield conversion are strong enough to survive a clean all-in without Ignite — burn it the moment you commit at level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: The win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (646 Aatrox-vs-Mordekaiser games, 51.1% Aatrox win rate). The trade-timing, passive-stack, and combo-window reasoning is our own tactical read on top of that data, not part of the measured numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with (E) while using [Q]. Do not let his (P) continue to activate by dealing small bursts of damage.
